submission.title: Reuse the upstream cubic polarization identity
submission.claim: For every commutative ring R and x, y, z in R, the selected theorem proves 24*x*y*z = (x+y+z)^3 - (x+y-z)^3 - (x-y+z)^3 + (x-y-z)^3. It preserves the upstream statement and ring proof. The local work packages the existing theorem in the pinned source-bundle format with a specific Mathlib import; it provides a small reusable algebraic identity, not progress on a complexity bound.
submission.novelty: No new mathematical statement or proof argument is contributed. The upstream proof already establishes this exact identity. Local changes remove an unused project import, narrow the Mathlib import and package the source; they add no theorem strength or new reasoning. This direct-reuse case has little incremental mathematical value and does not claim toolchain-migration work.
